Your free trial includes every Business feature, except removing CourseLit branding. Marketing emails start once you're on a paid plan.

items.question: How does the free trial work?
items.answer: Your trial lasts 14 days, needs no card and includes every Business feature except removing CourseLit branding. You get one trial per account.

items.question: What happens if I don't pick a plan after the trial?
items.answer: Your school becomes read-only for 15 days so you can still choose a plan. After that, the school and its data are deleted.

items.question: Why can't I send marketing emails during the trial?
items.answer: Marketing emails, such as broadcasts, sequences and drip emails, start once you're on Pro or Business. Your learners still get sign-in codes, receipts and access emails during the trial.

items.question: Do you charge a fee on my sales?
items.answer: No. Learners pay through your own Stripe, Lemon Squeezy or Razorpay account, and CourseLit takes no transaction fee on any plan. Your payment provider's own fees still apply.

items.question: Can I cancel my plan?
items.answer: Yes, from Billing and plan in your dashboard. Your plan stays active until the end of the period you paid for, and you can resume it before then.

items.question: Is the self-hosted version limited in any way?
items.answer: No. Self-hosted CourseLit has every feature, with no licence key and no limits. You run and pay for your own servers, database, storage and email service.
